## History

Rusty was a stray cat who was adopted by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) prior to her leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), after an attempt to chloroform him failed. Upon moving to Patty's Place, he was quickly dominated by the [Sarah-cat](../character/sarah-cat.md). He initially fought repeatedly with Aunt Jamesina's cat [Joseph](../character/joseph.md), but the two eventually became close friends.

_Sources: [v3 ch.Relationships P0](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0000), [v3 ch.Relationships P2](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0002), [v3 ch.Relationships P44](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0044), [v3 ch.Relationships P53](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0053), [v3 ch.Relationships P58](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0058), [v3 ch.Relationships P62](../source/v03-c16.md#nw-v03-c16-p0062), +1 more_

## Relationships

### [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/joseph--rusty.md)

Rusty initially engaged in repeated battles with [Joseph](../character/joseph.md) upon arriving at Patty's Place. Over time, their dynamic changed completely as they moved past being sworn enemies to become sworn friends who even slept on the same cushion.
